messages:
Alex: Heads up — p99 latency in us-west-2 jumped ~3x at 15:12 UTC. Seen on model-serving lines, not just one tenant. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.test/ops/serving/us-west-2.
Morgan: I can repro in profiler. Sampling shows a hot loop of kernel-selection probes when seq_len distribution flips between short+long.
Sophie: kv-cache evictions spiking at same time? I see eviction rate ~4x and a bunch of cold misses. Might be eviction + kernel thrash interaction.
Dan: incident-bot — opening incident: INC-2026-487. Adding oncall.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-487 created by Dan. Severity: P2 — latency spike across serving-host pool. Notify: #status-incidents.
Alex: Quick check — any recent rollout? eng-releases shows no runtime kernel changes in the last 24h. There was a new batching heuristic tweak rolled to canary though.
Morgan: I ran a microtrace:
```
trace: kernel_probe_select() -> try_variant_fast() -> fallback_probe_kernel() xN
time per probe ~ 0.8ms extra when switching variants frequently
cpu stalls on kernel lookup cache misses
```
Morgan: The probe frequency spikes when request size mix oscillates. Batching agent tries to pick kernel per-batch and we frequently rebuild meta leading to bad cache locality.
Sophie: For KV cache — hot keys are getting evicted because tenant 3427 is doing large long-context runs and evicting short-prefixed sessions. We can pin prefixes for latency-critical tenants.
Dan: Mitigations to try (fast):
- enable routing to model-compat-small for tenant 3427 (less kv pressure)
- flip feature flag: runtime.kernel_probe_sample_rate -> 0.05 (was 0.3)
- apply per-tenant batching cap to limit batch size for noisy tenant
I can patch and roll in 2m.
Alex: +1 to all. Also add temporary throttle on tenant 3427 to reduce eviction churn.
Lina OpsBot: Running command: `rbctl route apply --tenant 3427 --target model-compat-small --priority 90`
Lina OpsBot: Feature flag update: `ffctl set runtime.kernel_probe_sample_rate 0.05 --env prod` (rolling).
Morgan: Patch applied to sampling rate and route updated. Monitoring in progress.
Sophie: I enabled kv-pin for tenant 3427 on the hot-prefix set. Will monitor evictions.
Dan: Throttle put in: `quota set tenant:3427 req_per_s 40` — temporary for 20m.
Alex: Observability now — p99 trending down. Eviction rate halved, kernel probe count dropped ~70%.
incident-bot: INC-2026-487 updated: mitigations applied. Monitoring for 30m.
Morgan: Perf traces post-mitigation: no more rapid kernel swaps; per-request extra probe ~0.12ms.
Sophie: KV cache stabilized, miss rate back to baseline.
Dan: Leaving the throttle for 10 more minutes, then will set to soft limit. We should follow up with a proper fix: batching heuristics should avoid per-batch kernel churn for mixed-length workloads, and kv cache should support prefix pinning autopolicy.
Alex: Agreed — created follow-up task RNW-546: batching heuristic smoothing + kv autopin. Assigned to Morgan + Sophie.
Lina OpsBot: Incident INC-2026-487 resolved (status: mitigated). Postmortem draft: https://docs.redwood/test/pm/INC-2026-487-draft.
Alex: Thanks team. Quick retrospective: we need a controlled experiment harness for mixed-length sequences and a profiler alert when kernel probe rate > X/sec.
Morgan: I'll add a profiler alert and a loadtest variant today.
Sophie: I'll scope the KV autopin PR.
Dan: Closing thread once postmortem is published.
Alex: :thumbsup:
